title: Serpent and Polluted Eclipse
description: A massive purple serpent with open jaws and glowing eye coils in the right foreground beside a winding road with cars. The left foreground features tall green wildflowers and rocky terrain. In the sky looms a giant dark planet with colorful nebulae and orange glow, wrapped in black ethereal bands, while a polluted industrial city billows thick black smoke in the background.
prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape showing a giant purple snake with open mouth and orange eye in the foreground on the right, dramatic dark celestial body with colorful nebula and orange rim surrounded by black swirling energy bands dominating the sky, polluted futuristic city with many smokestacks emitting thick black smoke on the right, winding road with cars leading toward the city, tall green wildflowers and rocky terrain on the left foreground, dramatic cinematic lighting, apocalyptic atmosphere
